question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many orders are completed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: What is the average price of products?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question: What is the total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items

question: What is the total quantity sold?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items

question: What is the highest price of products?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM products

question: What is the minimum price of products?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(price) FROM products

question: List customers in Chennai
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Chennai'

question: Customers in the USA
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'USA'

question: Which product is the most expensive?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the cheapest product
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1

question: Show products in the Electronics category
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics'

question: How many products are in the Books category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Books'

question: What is the average price of products in the Beauty category?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(p.price) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Beauty'

question: Products with price over 100
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > 100

question: Products with stock below 10
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE stock < 10

question: Which products have a price greater than 200?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > 200

question: List customers with loyalty tier gold
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE loyalty_tier = 'gold'

question: Count orders by status
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: Count of customers by loyalty tier
gold_sql: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier

question: Top 5 customers by total spending
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Bottom 3 products by price
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which customer has the highest total spending?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders does each customer have?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Customers who signed up after 2024-06-01
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date > '2024-06-01'

question: Orders placed between 2024-01-01 and 2024-03-01
gold_sql: SELECT order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-01'

question: List all suppliers
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT supplier FROM products

question: How many categories are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories

question: What is the average unit price of order items?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM order_items

question: How many orders does Diego Sharma have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Diego Sharma'

question: Which customer has placed the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which category has the most products?
gold_sql: SELECT cat.name, COUNT(*) FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.category_id GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of orders are cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: Show customers who have never placed an order
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: What is the median price of products?
gold_sql: SELECT price FROM products ORDER BY price LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products) / 2
